comment: AIRGAP package catalog (v0.4.0). Packages install WITHOUT internet: artifacts are dropped manually on the server in <datapath>/plugins/pkgmanager/store/<package-id>/<artifact-file> and the agent downloads them from THIS server over the LAN. Per-OS install definition: type 1=Windows cmd.exe, 2=PowerShell, 3=Linux/macOS shell. A def with 'artifact' requires that file in the store and supports {{url}} (LAN URL from this server, token included) and {{sha384}} (server-computed artifact hash) placeholders. Artifact-missing packages show a disabled Install button with the drop path in the tooltip. Downloads use relaxed TLS (-k / self-signed LAN certs) ON PURPOSE: MeshCentral default certs are self-signed, so artifact INTEGRITY is guaranteed by the SHA-384 check, not by TLS. Runs as the agent; commands needing root must include sudo or run elevated. timeout = seconds.

packages.name: E2E smoke test
packages.description: Baseline smoke: prints a marker (no system change, no artifact).

packages.name: E2E airgap smoke (store artifact)
packages.description: Airgap path: downloads the artifact from THIS server over LAN, verifies SHA-384, runs it (no system change).

packages.name: htop (offline .deb)
packages.description: Offline install from a .deb dropped in the server store (store/htop-offline/htop_amd64.deb). Install button enables as soon as the file is there.

packages.name: 7-Zip (offline MSI)
packages.description: Offline install from an MSI dropped in the server store (store/7zip-offline/7z2408-x64.msi). Windows agent must run elevated for msiexec.
